text:
Recent research supports separating recommendation relationships from user intent. [Beyond Clicks (2025)](https://eprints.gla.ac.uk/361827/) studies Exact, Substitute, Complement and Irrelevant recommendations, emphasizing context; these relationships do not establish ownership, compatibility or immediate purchase intent. [Fashion-AlterEval (2025)](https://eprints.gla.ac.uk/366157/) highlights limitations of single-target evaluation and indefinitely patient simulators. For this audit, use separate fields for immediate choice, general/deferred interest, explicitly reported duplication or incompatibility, and unidentified content; permit overlapping labels. Treat title/description matches as hypotheses requiring user confirmation.

Annotation reliability needs direct measurement. [Sources of Disagreement (2025)](https://aclanthology.org/2025.comedi-1.3/) finds that task formulation and annotator changes affect labels; pairwise preference annotation is not inherently higher quality than single-item annotation. [Research on ties (2025)](https://papers.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2025/hash/4dbf3488a8da908a8177d525ede1a43a-Abstract-Conference.html) supports retaining indifference, while [bounded-abstention ranking (2025)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.23437) addresses uncertain comparisons. These are methodological precedents, not validation of this taxonomy. Recommended protocol: independently double-code feedback, retain evidence excerpts, report raw agreement and a chance-corrected coefficient, and distinguish ties from insufficient-information abstentions. Annotators code reported intent; they cannot establish a user's intent by consensus.

For the twenty users, compare specific recent-purpose matches against plausible alternatives with randomized presentation and explicit reasons. Record user judgments, GRU score margins and rank changes before/after a revision; report agreement between proxy labels and explicit judgments, including unknowns. This proposed audit establishes neither causality nor population-wide gains. Keep unsupported ownership and intent unknown, and keep these diagnostics separate from fixed macro validation HR@10 and the single trained model per category.
